content.comment_body: Why does the new app version (10.4.0) crash unexpectedly? On my Apple iPhone 5S, every time I try to configure a parameter, the app closes on its own. My device is upgraded to iOS 10.3.2 (14F89). Thank you ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [article_no] app.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that the newest version of a [company_name] app (10.4.0) repeatedly crashes on their iPhone 5S with iOS 10.3.2, especially during parameter configuration. This prevents them from completing important tasks and leads to frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the app to work reliably and not crash, especially during routine operations such as setting parameters.
